camera.title: Bedroom 1 - frontal view of the bed wall
camera.notes: Frontal view of the bed wall: vertical walnut slats with a warm wash light at the top, a tall olive velvet channel headboard, cream travertine nightstands, opal globe pendants, ivory bedding, an ivory rug; deep olive plaster walls; the full-height french window with sheer curtains on the left letting golden light in.
